guide: Qualys API (VM and PA) User Guide

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Lists IP assets in the subscription.

parameters.name: echo_request
parameters.description: Echoes submitted parameters in the XML response when set to 1.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: Filters by comma-separated IPv4 addresses or ranges.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: Filters by a custom network ID when Network Support is enabled.

parameters.name: tracking_method
parameters.description: Filters assets by their tracking method.

parameters.name: compliance_enabled
parameters.description: Filters for IPs enabled (1) or not enabled (0) for Policy Compliance.

parameters.name: certview_enabled
parameters.description: Filters for IPs enabled (1) or not enabled (0) for Certificate View.

operations.name: Add IP addresses - V2

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Adds IP assets to the subscription.

parameters.name: enable_vm
parameters.description: Enables or disables Vulnerability Management for the new IPs.

parameters.name: enable_pc
parameters.description: Enables or disables Policy Compliance for the new IPs.

parameters.name: enable_sca
parameters.description: Enables or disables Security Configuration Assessment for the new IPs.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: Provides IPv4 addresses, ranges, or CIDR values to add.

parameters.name: echo_request
parameters.description: Echoes submitted parameters in the XML response when set to 1.

parameters.name: tracking_method
parameters.description: Sets the initial tracking method for the added IPs.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Assigns an eligible Manager or permitted Unit Manager as owner.

parameters.name: ud1
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 1.

parameters.name: ud2
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 2.

parameters.name: ud3
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 3.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Sets the user-defined comment.

parameters.name: ag_title
parameters.description: Identifies the Unit Manager asset group for the new IPs.

parameters.name: enable_certview
parameters.description: Enables or disables Certificate View for the new IPs.

operations.coverage: form request built; CSV raw-data variant pending

operations.name: Update IP addresses - V2

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Updates existing IP assets in the subscription.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.description: Identifies IPv4 addresses, ranges, or CIDR values to update.

parameters.name: echo_request
parameters.description: Echoes submitted parameters in the XML response when set to 1.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.description: Restricts the update to a custom network ID when Network Support is enabled.

parameters.name: tracking_method
parameters.description: Updates the tracking method; EC2 and Agent tracking cannot be changed.

parameters.name: host_dns
parameters.description: Updates DNS hostname for a single matching IP.

parameters.name: host_netbios
parameters.description: Updates NetBIOS hostname for a single matching IP.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Updates the asset owner.

parameters.name: ud1
parameters.description: Updates user-defined field 1.

parameters.name: ud2
parameters.description: Updates user-defined field 2.

parameters.name: ud3
parameters.description: Updates user-defined field 3.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Updates the user-defined comment.

operations.coverage: form request built; CSV raw-data variant pending
